items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: Harry lived here in Vegas so I got to see him frequently at different benefits and things.

ctx.x: Did you have any trumpet heroes growing up?

Well I think the same ones everybody did: Harry James, Louis Armstrong of course, Harry James. Incidentally I did a show with Louis Armstrong called “Hollywood Palace” in Hollywood obviously, and hung out with Louis Armstrong for three days and he was the most amazing human being. He told me stories too, I mean boy, he was the best. And then Harry James took it to the next level. Harry lived here in Vegas so I got to see him frequently at different benefits and things.
